item.name: Expedition Center
item.cardSummary: The hub for Expedition progression. Its level gates upgrades for the other buildings, so it sets the ceiling for the whole area.
item.function: Controls Expedition progression and unlocks higher levels for the surrounding buildings.
item.unlockDependency: Reach player level 20 and unlock Expedition mode.

item.name: Research Lab
item.cardSummary: Turns Expedition Coins into permanent upgrades for economy, payload strength, unit power, and progression across future runs.
item.function: Opens a permanent upgrade tree with economy, payload, power, and progression branches.
item.unlockDependency: Requires access to the Expedition Hub; later research tiers depend on earlier nodes.

item.name: Gold Mine
item.cardSummary: Consumes stored Fuel Cells to make Gold passively. Higher building levels improve the return from the same limited fuel supply.
item.function: Converts Expedition Fuel into passive Gold production.
item.unlockDependency: Higher mine levels require the Expedition Center to be upgraded first.

item.name: Resource Drill
item.cardSummary: Uses Fuel Cells to mine Geodes. Opening those Geodes can return rerolls, Trait Crystals, Gems, and other useful materials.
item.function: Converts Expedition Fuel into Geodes that open into account resources.
item.unlockDependency: Its first build uses Expedition Coins and Cursed Timber from School Grounds.

item.name: Armory
item.cardSummary: Handles the Expedition equipment loop. You can craft gear from Scrap, reroll its stats, or dismantle unwanted pieces.
item.function: Forges, rerolls, and dismantles equipment for stronger unit builds.

item.name: Quest Board
item.cardSummary: Offers recurring Expedition goals that pay progression resources. It is a steady source of rewards while you build out the Hub.
item.function: Tracks recurring Expedition objectives and milestone rewards.
item.output: Gold, Gems, Expedition Coins, and reroll items

item.name: Expedition Shop
item.cardSummary: Spends Expedition Coins on materials and reroll resources. Its stock can rotate, so the shop matters more as a currency outlet than a fixed item roster.
item.function: Trades Expedition Coins for resources, materials, and reroll items.

item.name: Training Grounds
item.cardSummary: Parks idle units to gain Unit EXP and Worthiness over time. It helps the bench grow, but it does not solve Expedition resource shortages.
item.function: Lets assigned idle units earn Unit EXP and Worthiness on a passive timer.
